claims: Riley Green is a country singer.
Riley Green makes his acting debut on the CBS Yellowstone spin-off series Marshals.
Riley Green's first appearance on Marshals is in season 1, episode 8, "Blowback".
Season 1, episode 8, "Blowback" of Marshals airs on April 19, 2026.
Riley Green plays Garrett on Marshals.
Garrett is a troubled former Navy SEAL teammate of Kayce Dutton.
Kayce Dutton is played by Luke Grimes.
Riley Green is set to appear in multiple episodes of Marshals, starting April 19.
Riley Green will be involved in a storyline on Marshals that blends his musical background with acting.
Riley Green's role on Marshals came about through his friendship with Luke Grimes.
Luke Grimes encouraged Riley Green to pursue acting.
